title: Section 2 test
intro: Lessons 8 to 14. Three short parts: match words, fill a gap, then finish a conversation. Pass with 70% or higher.

parts.title: Part 3 · Conversation
parts.intro: Pick the line that fits the scene.

questions.question: burek
questions.explanation: Burek is the meat-filled pastry Emir loves.

questions.question: Koliko košta?
questions.explanation: Koliko košta? is the price question at a shop or café.

questions.question: imam
questions.explanation: Imam means I have. Želim means I want.

questions.question: Odakle si?
questions.explanation: Odakle si? asks where someone is from.

questions.question: Ne _____ luk.
questions.explanation: Ne volim means I do not like. Ne volim luk is I do not like onion.

questions.question: _____ krevet.
questions.explanation: Imam krevet means I have a bed.

questions.question: _____ je vrijeme?
questions.explanation: Kakvo je vrijeme? asks what the weather is like.

questions.question: Hajde da _____.
questions.explanation: Hajde da idemo is a friendly let's go.

questions.question: Amira: Burek ili sirnica? Emir: _____.
questions.explanation: Emir orders burek with meat. S mesom means with meat.

questions.question: Seller: Izvoli. Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: At the counter you ask Koliko košta? before you pay.

questions.question: Ana: Kakvo je vrijeme? Emir: _____. Idemo kući.
questions.explanation: Pada kiša means it is raining. That is why they head home.

questions.question: New friend: Odakle si? Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: Odakle si? wants an origin. Ja sam iz Amerike answers it.
